text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOH!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Do you dare, Lord Gimlet! Come! Charge 
down this cliff and strike me down!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I saw right through your ambush! As if 
something like that would work on me... 
wait, what?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WHAM!)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Ow-ow-ow-ow-ow?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason's pace suddenly slows down. 
Influenced by it, Tanino Gimlet's stride 
loses its momentum too.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
No Reason isn't accelerating! Tanino 
Gimlet fails to find more as well!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Nwoh, how could this beeeee!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Ghk, was I... deceived by a trap?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something happened. And neither of them 
was able to claim victory.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Ow-ow-ow...! How pathetic of me...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's nothin' serious. Just gave the 
toes on my left foot a right proper 
thwack...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
What a blunder... To let myself be 
distracted on the battlefield.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Though she didn't win, it didn't result 
in anything serious, which is what matters 
most. And—"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Lord Gimlet, Lord Kris S, our spring has 
come to an end. However—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The final crown still remains. The autumn 
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Needless—to say.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... You preach the path to the 
fourth ice wall, do you, commander of the 
east?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
By the way... Lord Gimlet, after running 
today, something crossed my mind—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: We're quite similar, the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Similar—did you say?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, the arrogance in your running in 
particular is quite similar. Therefore—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
That makes me even less willing to back 
down! Especially to you!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, a resemblance of souls? If so— then 
one half of this alter ego must fall to 
the shadows.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Only one may pass through the gates of 
hell. Perish, or make me fall!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Clashing in full glory before 
scattering is the true flower of battle! 
Though naturally, I shall not be the one 
to scatter. Bwahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What the two have in common. It isn't just 
arrogance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A certain kind of "purity of resolve." 
It's because she has this that, quirky 
though her personality may be, she somehow 
remains refreshing.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now then, next is the Kikuka Sho... but I 
highly doubt getting there will be a 
smooth road.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Feels like something is about to happen 
again, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Failing to register for the Satsuki Sho. 
And the utter chaos before the Japan 
Derby...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Things keep happening to the point where 
one might wonder if she's possessed by a 
vengeful spirit. Chances are, something 
will happen next time, too...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
However, we must endure! Just one more 
battle remains until we clear the gateway 
of the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"The Kikuka-sho! I shall reach it without 
fail and smash through all misfortune!"
